question: Government in Budget 2023-24 has made announcement of Pradhan Mantri PVTG Development Mission for implementing targeted schemes for socially and economically backward Scheduled tribes. Here PVTGs stands for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the Budget 2023-24, the government announced the **Pradhan Mantri PVTG Development Mission**
 
• **It is **implemented to target schemes for socially and economically backwards Scheduled Tribes.
 
 
• Especially for **PVTGs** that stands for **Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups**.
 
 
 
• **Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs)** are a subset of Scheduled Tribes (STs) in India
 
• It is recognized as being more vulnerable due to factors like
 
 
• low population growth, dependence on primitive agriculture, and lack of education and healthcare.
 
 
 
• The **PVTG Development Mission** aims to improve the socio-economic conditions of these groups by implementing focused and need-based programs.
